column3: vt. 根除, 杜绝, 使脱离传统
column5: War and exile deracinated whole villages, scattering families across three continents.
column6: 战争与流放使整座村庄背井离乡,家族流散三大洲。

column3: v. 除去盐分, 淡化海水
column5: The coastal plant desalinizes seawater for half a million residents every day.
column6: 这座海滨工厂每天为五十万居民淡化海水。

column3: vt. 看出, 看见, 发现
column5: Through the fog the lookout struggled to descry a distant sail bearing north.
column6: 瞭望员透过雾气努力辨认远处一张向北的船帆。

column3: vt. 使干, 干贮;vi. 变干
column5: Farmers desiccate the plums in the sun to preserve them for winter.
column6: 农民把李子摊在日光下晒干,好保存过冬。

column3: a. 可破坏的
column5: Every destructible component of the probe will burn up during reentry.
column6: 探测器上所有可焚毁的部件都会在再入大气层时烧尽。

column3: v. (使)荒废, (使)毁坏
column5: Decades of neglect left the grand old hotel dilapidated and officially unsafe.
column6: 多年失修使这家昔日气派的老酒店破败成危楼。

column3: n. 嗜酒症, 饮酒狂;间发性酒狂
column5: His dipsomania worsened after retirement, worrying both his doctor and his daughters.
column6: 退休后他的嗜酒症加重,医生和女儿们都很忧心。

column3: vt. 使疏远, 使不忠, 使不满意
column5: The sudden pay freeze disaffected even the most loyal civil servants.
column6: 突如其来的薪资冻结连最忠诚的公务员也心生不满。

column3: vt. 使混乱, 使困惑, 使泄气
column5: The last-minute schedule change discombobulated the entire film crew.
column6: 临时改动的日程把整个摄制组搅得晕头转向。

column3: v. 使为难( discomfit的过去式和过去分词); 使狼狈; 使挫折; 挫败
column5: The candidate looked discomfited when a student questioned his voting record.
column6: 被学生质疑投票记录时,这位候选人显得狼狈不堪。

column3: vt. 使清醒
column5: Years of broken promises disenchanted the party's youngest and loudest supporters.
column6: 多年屡屡失信,使该党最年轻、最活跃的支持者不再抱有幻想。

column3: vt. 剥夺公民权, 剥夺推举议员权, 夺权利;剥夺公民权, 剥夺选举权, 终止特许权
column5: The law formerly disfranchised citizens who could not pass a literacy test.
column6: 这部法律曾经剥夺了未通过识字测验的公民的选举权。

column3: vt. 使不高兴
column5: The new rota disgruntled nurses who had already covered three night shifts.
column6: 新的排班表惹恼了已经连上三个夜班的护士们。

column3: vt. 使蓬乱, 使头发凌乱
column5: A sudden downpour disheveled the delegates hurrying between the two conference halls.
column6: 一场骤雨把在两个会场之间奔走的代表们浇得狼狈不堪。

column3: n. 反证, 反驳;反证, 反证物, 反驳
column5: The fossil record offers strong disproof of that early theory of species.
column6: 化石记录为那个早期的物种理论提供了有力的反证。

column3: v. 使变色,弄脏,伤害名誉
column5: Rust distains the fountain's pale stone with long orange streaks.
column6: 铁锈在喷泉的浅色石面上留下长长的橙色污痕。

column3: a. 心不在焉的
column5: Grief left her distrait, missing exits on roads she had driven for years.
column6: 悲伤使她神思恍惚,开熟了多年的路也会错过出口。

column3: v. 流浪, 漫游,离题
column5: The lecturer tends to divagate from medieval trade into modern politics.
column6: 这位讲师常常从中世纪贸易扯到现代政治,离题万里。

column3: adv. 隐秘地；躲藏地；一动也不动地
column5: The old sheepdog lies doggo by the stove until the flock goes out.
column6: 老牧羊犬趴在炉边一动不动,直到羊群放出去了才起身。

column3: a. 悦目的, 美妙的, 美味的, 悦耳的
column5: The choir's dulcet harmonies drifted across the courtyard at evensong.
column6: 晚祷时分,唱诗班甜美的和声飘过庭院。

column3: a. 震耳欲聋的
column5: An earsplitting whistle announced that the last train was about to leave.
column6: 一声震耳欲聋的汽笛宣告末班车即将发车。

column3: a. 惊天动地的
column5: The lab's earthshaking result forced physicists to rethink standard theory overnight.
column6: 实验室这一惊世发现迫使物理学家连夜反思标准理论。

column3: n. 蜕皮, 蜕化;蜕皮, 换羽
column5: The crab hides in rock crevices during ecdysis, while its new shell is soft.
column6: 蜕壳期间的螃蟹藏进岩缝,那时它的壳还很软。

column3: a. 光辉灿烂的
column5: The effulgent sunrise drew early hikers up to the eastern ridge.
column6: 灿烂的日出把早起的远足者吸引上东面山脊。

column3: a. 最高天的, 九天的, 苍天的
column5: The astronomer spoke of empyreal regions far beyond any telescope's reach.
column6: 天文学家谈起远非任何望远镜所能企及的九天之上。

column3: n. 最高天, 九天, 苍天
column5: At night the desert sky becomes a burning empyrean of stars.
column6: 入夜后,沙漠上空化作一片炽烈燃烧的星辰苍穹。

column3: vt. 译成密码;编码
column5: The clerk enciphered the message before sending it across the insecure line.
column6: 文书先将电文加密,再经不安全的线路发出。

column3: n. 宣读或写作颂辞之人, 赞美者, 阿谀者
column5: The biography's author proves more an encomiast than an honest chronicler.
column6: 这部传记的作者更像吹鼓手,而非诚实的记录者。

column3: vt. 给...上脚镣, 束缚, 使受制于
column5: The naval treaty enfettered the fleet with strict limits on tonnage and bases.
column6: 海军条约以吨位和基地的严苛限制捆住了舰队手脚。

column3: v. 燃烧
column5: A single leaked memo enflamed the dispute between the two departments.
column6: 一份泄露的备忘录把两部门之间的争端点着了。
